pitch: How a military force built for efficiency learned adaptability: shared consciousness and empowered execution.
br: Building your own team of teams
quiz: Why was McChrystal's force losing at first?
A structure too slow against a networked adversary
The problem wasn't competence, but structure.
What is the difference between complicated and complex?
Complicated is predictable with enough analysis; complex remains unpredictable
In a complex system, small causes can have large, unpredictable effects.
What goal should replace efficiency according to the authors?
The ability to react quickly and intelligently to the unexpected.
Teams linked to each other by bonds of trust, like members of a team
A whole organization can't be one team, but its teams can trust one another.
What is the daily O&I briefing for?
Creating a common understanding shared by thousands of people
Each team shares what it has done, learned and what it needs.
Why send very good officers as liaison officers?
To show the importance of these relationships and build trust
Distrust of a group becomes trust in people.
What happens if you delegate without sharing information?
Shared consciousness must come before empowered execution.
What image does McChrystal adopt for the leader?
He creates the conditions in which teams can act on their own.
